cleaning.rule: Decode UTF-8 or UTF-16, with or without a byte order mark; a file that decodes as neither fails the check.
Lower-case the whole text, names included.
Join line continuations: a backtick, caret or backslash before a newline, and any newline inside an open bracket.
Drop cmd carets and PowerShell backticks anywhere.
Drop single and double quotes anywhere.
Read the en dash, em dash and horizontal bar as a hyphen, and a hyphen or a slash as the same switch marker.
Ignore spaces and tabs before an opening bracket and around a dot.

controls.text: for r, d, f in os . walk (x): pass

cleaning.rule: Read a from-import name and an import-as alias as the dotted name it stands for.

controls.text:
from os import walk
for r, d, f in walk(x): pass

import shutil as s
s.copytree(a, b)

cleaning.rule: A switch row also refuses a splatted argument (@name), whose switches cannot be read.
Scan every tracked file except the listed data types and the two table files; a file with no extension is scanned as text, and a tracked type on neither list fails the check.

excluded.name: Remove-Item -Recurse
excluded.reason: Measured on a Windows test PC under Windows PowerShell 5.1: it removes a junction, a directory symbolic link and a mount point without deleting through them.

excluded.reason: Measured on a Windows test PC: both remove links as links without entering them.
